reason: PURE. The first thing I noticed was the QR code and "Every batch lab-tested" on the front, because proof is the only thing that gets a supplement past me. The sachets are handy for my work trips, so I would try one box and see if sleep or cramps change.
objection: Will I actually feel a difference in sleep or cramps? Most supplements are marketing, and a lab report shows what is in the capsule, not that it does anything for me.
would_change_my_mind: Opening the QR report and seeing a real named lab with magnesium content that matches the label. If it were missing or vague, I would pass.
